guestGuide.achievements: Collect achievements across different aspects of the site to level up Milestones and compete with other players.
guestGuide.chat: Join conversations and channels, share GIFs and emojis, find players, or ask Smiley for help with the website.
guestGuide.settings: Customise your profile picture and personalise your experience with a multitude of themes and settings. Choose from a selection of music and sound options to enhance your experience.
guestGuide.games: Play both classic and original games such as Bulls & Cows, Number Pillars, chess, a variety of card games, Minecraft, and Streetfighter.
guestGuide.blog: Read posts and explore community polls and suggestions. Sign in to take part in a world of discussions and community engagement.
guestGuide.gacha: Draw shards and unlock rarer possibilities as you reach new milestones.
